identity.baseline: monaco-editor-core@0.56.0 final editor.main.js closure on Google Chrome 151.0.7922.109

v8.use: behavioral provenance for Chrome binary64 transcendental outputs only; no V8 runtime or source is linked into MonaCode

packageInventory.rule: The 14 nls.messages JavaScript tables are N1-owned generated localization authority inputs, not executable product modules. The two public declaration files are F1-owned. Source maps, package metadata, README, version and notice files are oracle/provenance inputs and do not enter the signed native runtime. Codicon TTF is the sole non-source runtime asset in the fixed core package; the package contains no WASM file.

unreachableVsJavaScript.rule: These 38 files have no static path from editor.main.js. The only runtime ImportExpression in the 956-module graph targets D1 external diff instead of this set; the two string-built worker loaders are under the complete WebWorker cut. Direct internal ESM deep-import compatibility is outside the native public contract. MonaSourceClosureManifest records all 38 as package-exclusion rows and cites an existing G4 cut, owner or baseline-unreachable fact; none creates a retained native source obligation by itself.

runtimeDynamicImportExpressions.disposition: D1 fixed-baseline unavailable for advanced-external and advanced-wasm; no native loader or fallback

moduleAndResourceClosure.generatedWorkerDisposition: The string-built await import in webWorkerServiceImpl belongs to the complete WebWorker cut and never executes in MonaCode.
moduleAndResourceClosure.rule: MonaSourceClosureManifest.json must be set-equal to all 956 reachable JavaScript modules, all 98 imported style resources, all 38 unreachable-package JavaScript exclusion rows, every direct global reference and every retained platform-effect call site. It also cross-references the 14 N1-owned localization tables and three unreachable style resources. Each row records source hash, location, source role, disposition, native symbol and fixture identity. Counts without rows fail C04 and C10.
moduleAndResourceClosure.closedWorldDispositionRule: Every observable behavior in the 956 modules and 98 imported resources is retained exact by default. A row can differ only by citing an explicit G4 cut, G4 native adaptation, G4 baseline-inert path or G4 later-platform target. MonaSourceClosureManifest cannot introduce a new cut, no-op, fallback, native adaptation, later target or implementation discretion; doing so is a scope change and fails C04/C10.

directGlobalClosure.memberNameFalsePositive: The sole syntactic .fetch() call is InlineCompletionsSource.fetch; it is not the network Fetch API.
directGlobalClosure.codeGeneration: There is no eval call and no Function constructor. Reflect.decorate and descriptor helpers are emitted module wiring and receive explicit build-eliminated rows instead of a native reflection runtime.

intrinsicOperationProfiles.finitePortRule: MonaCode does not implement or expose a general JavaScript runtime. It implements the finite operation profiles exercised by retained source rows, with Chrome 151 as the observable oracle; cut, native-adapted and emitted-build rows do not create generic intrinsic APIs.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.binary64: All retained arithmetic, comparison, signed-zero, NaN, infinity, ToInt32, ToUint32, parseInt, parseFloat, Number conversion and Math operation profiles preserve Chrome binary64 results and control-flow decisions. Swift rounding, integer conversion and Darwin libm are not semantic oracles. The candidate supplies raw-bit differential vectors for every retained Math member and every threshold branch.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.objectAndEnumeration: Own string-key enumeration uses ECMAScript array-index ordering followed by insertion order; property replacement keeps position, deletion plus reinsertion moves the key, and prototype or descriptor behavior is retained only at source rows that observe it. Swift Dictionary order is never an oracle.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.collections: Array, Map and Set retain insertion order, alias identity, SameValueZero key equality, stable source sort and mutation-during-iteration behavior at retained rows. WeakMap and WeakRef rows map to H2-owned weak native references; release timing cannot alter a published result or event trace.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.json: The repository raw-UTF16 JSON codec covers all 19 parse and 54 stringify references. It preserves source-specific replacers, toJSON adapters, key order, duplicate-key last-value parsing, negative zero, non-finite-number null conversion, undefined omission or array-null conversion, exact escapes and error categories. L2-R3 remains the stricter LSP wire profile.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.promises: Promise construction, resolve, reject, all, allSettled and race map to repository thenables and the E1 MainActor microtask queue. Settlement, assimilation, rejection and callback order are source-exact; native async tasks cannot publish outside the existing validity gate.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.errors: Error, TypeError and AggregateError map to typed native errors with exact source control flow, message identity and ordered aggregate members. JavaScript stack formatting is not public and is replaced by sanitized H1 diagnostics.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.symbolsAndReflection: Iterator, asyncIterator, dispose and toStringTag rows map to typed Swift protocols. Proxy, Reflect and Object descriptor rows are individually classified as retained behavior, native data structure, emitted-build wiring or cut; no public Symbol, Proxy, prototype or property-descriptor API is added.
intrinsicOperationProfiles.typedMemory: ArrayBuffer, DataView and all six typed-array profiles use explicit byte order, wrapping, overlap and alias rules. No native-memory layout assumption crosses a public or wire boundary.

clockAndPerformanceCorrection.wallClock: Date.now and StopWatch(false) use the injected Unix-epoch integer-millisecond wall clock and observe wall-clock jumps.
clockAndPerformanceCorrection.highResolutionClock: The 13 retained high-resolution StopWatch sites and the input-latency recorder use an injected mach_absolute_time-domain clock. Production converts the Mach timebase to binary64 milliseconds; system sleep is excluded exactly as in Chromium 151 TimeTicks on macOS.
clockAndPerformanceCorrection.directPerformanceNow: Four direct calls occur only in the cut Tree-sitter path.
clockAndPerformanceCorrection.publicationRule: Clock reads used for debounce adaptation, timeout decisions, input-latency samples and emitted measurements retain their original clock domain and source ordering.

encodingAndHashing.modelBoundary: The text model, positions, selections and public text events remain raw UTF-16. Encoding replacement occurs only at the exact compatibility utilities listed below and never mutates model truth.
activeDecoderProfiles: StringBuilder UTF-16LE on current arm64 macOS
decodeUTF16LE with an explicit leading U+FEFF or U+FFFE preservation branch
rich-edit bracket code-unit reversal followed by the platform UTF-16 decoder
baselineInertProfiles: VSBuffer.toString UTF-8 decoder because the fixed 956-module graph has no call site
hashAsync TextEncoder plus crypto.subtle SHA-1 because the fixed graph has no hashAsync call site
encodingAndHashing.decoderRule: Default UTF-16 decoding removes a leading U+FEFF, preserves U+FFFE, preserves valid surrogate pairs and replaces each isolated surrogate with U+FFFD. decodeUTF16LE bypasses decoding when the first unit is U+FEFF or U+FFFE and preserves every unit in that branch.
encodingAndHashing.stringBuilderRule: Buffer flush keeps a valid surrogate pair in one decoder chunk; every isolated unit, reversed pair and leading-BOM case matches the fixed Chrome vectors.
encodingAndHashing.activeSha1: StringSHA1 is retained for ModelService and implements the source UTF-16-to-UTF-8 stream, including a high surrogate split across update calls. It emits lowercase 40-hex SHA-1 and does not call WebCrypto.

chromeVectors.splitSurrogateSha1: A high surrogate in one update and its low surrogate in the next update equals the whole-pair hash 82ab1e5bf66129bdbb3d5477dfe48bfcb2545cbd.

platformEffectDispositions.nativeUI: document, window, DOM classes, customElements, Animation, observers and event constructors map only to the already frozen AppKit, Core Text, Core Graphics, I3, I4 and A2 state machines. DOM and CSS APIs do not ship.
platformEffectDispositions.clipboard: ClipboardItem and navigator.clipboard map to the I4 NSPasteboard pipeline; browser execCommand copy, undo, redo and selectAll sites map to native command routes.
platformEffectDispositions.rendering: OffscreenCanvas, GPUBufferUsage, GPUTextureUsage and navigator.gpu belong to cut WebGPU paths; retained visual behavior is implemented by Core Graphics and the conditional Metal backend from V1-R4.
platformEffectDispositions.workers: Worker, Blob worker bootstrap, self, importScripts, postMessage and URL.createObjectURL belong to the WebWorker cut; retained worker computations use immutable native snapshots and explicit Swift execution lanes.
platformEffectDispositions.node: Buffer and process are absent in the fixed browser baseline. Native platform identity is the immutable E1 current-release profile; no environment variables, cwd or Node buffer mode are exposed.
platformEffectDispositions.urls: URL and URLSearchParams sites are classified as Markdown sanitization, browser-resource formatting, COI worker setup or worker URL construction. Retained logical URI behavior uses MonaURI and H1 openers; worker and DOM-sanitizer sites are cut or native-adapted and cannot start I/O.
platformEffectDispositions.diagnostics: console assert, trace, debug, log, info, warn and error sites map to nonthrowing sanitized H1 diagnostics or fixed no-op rows. They do not gain control-flow authority and do not emit document text.
platformEffectDispositions.crypto: crypto.randomUUID and getRandomValues use E1 injected cryptographic entropy. crypto.subtle belongs only to baseline-inert hashAsync.
platformEffectDispositions.networkAndPersistence: There is no direct Fetch, XHR, WebSocket, EventSource, Web Storage or IndexedDB global in the parsed closure. RemoteAuthorities remains E1 inert and H1 is the sole external side-effect boundary.

externalNavigationEmitters.disposition: H1 typed MonaLinkOpener route; no default native external opener
H1 typed MonaLinkOpener route; no default native external opener

markdownMediaActivationSites.disposition: MD1 media byte loading and playback cut; parsed alt text remains

native link state plus H1 opener
MD1 native semantic link, trust and opener policy
MD1 typed resolved MonaURI state; no resource load

valueOnlyMarkedTokenSrcSites.disposition: parser value fields, not I/O; MD1 native semantic nodes preserve parsed value/alt behavior under the media cut

environmentLocationReadSites.disposition: N1 immutable localization profile replaces URL-state selection
E1 RemoteAuthorities baseline-inert; no native URL-state read

uriBackedVisualAssets.producerEvidence: The 994-file vs source inventory has zero iconPath object-property initializers and zero iconPath property assignments. The fixed 121 menu-item registry has zero URI light/dark icon value; all present menu icons are ThemeIcon identities. languages.IconPath is editor.ThemeIcon. CommentAuthorInformation.iconPath is a retained UriComponents declaration field with no reachable source consumer or registered comments feature. Arbitrary IEditorOverrideServices injection is already replaced by typed F1/H1 overrides.
uriBackedVisualAssets.disposition: All ten URI-to-CSS visual call sites are baseline-inert for the fixed standalone product. Builtin visual icons resolve through T1 and the bundled Codicon font. No eighth resource-loader host group is added. Exposing a URI-backed quick-input/menu/icon-label/product-icon-font producer or a comments UI consumer is a G4 scope revision.

implicitExternalEffectClosure.rule: The absence of Fetch-like globals is not used as proof of zero external effects. These 14 DOM/URL/value sites are separately classified. No native row can open a URL, load media, navigate, create a worker URL or read browser location outside the cited H1, MD1, WebWorker, N1 or E1 disposition.

sourceSyntaxScan.validationParser: Lightning CSS 1.33.0 with CSS Nesting transform enabled
sourceSyntaxScan.rule: All 1281 source rule nodes and 3120 declarations receive a native-state row or an already accepted cut/later-target row. All 12 keyframe identities and 46 motion declarations retain their state transitions, timing, repetition and reduced-motion disposition.

styleVariableClosure.partitionRule: 216 registered theme-color names plus four non-theme source-declared names plus 37 initially unresolved names equal all 257 referenced names. The 37 split into 18 source-provided dynamic names, two fallback-only names and 17 fixed-standalone unprovided names. Their 23 plus 3 plus 48 references equal all 74 initially unresolved references.
styleVariableClosure.unprovidedRule: The 17 unprovided names are absent from the 431-color registry, absent from reachable source providers and empty at document root, editor host and editor node in the fixed Chrome standalone probe. Their 48 no-fallback declarations are inactive in the fixed standalone baseline and remain absent in native output; adding corner radius, shadow, banner/sidebar colors or compact typography at those rows is an unauthorized visual scope expansion.
styleVariableClosure.dynamicRule: The 18 dynamic names retain their source owner, lifetime, value and update trigger. The two fallback-only Codicon size names use their literal CSS fallback. Registered color variables resolve through T1, including undefined defaults; four source-only variables retain CSS lexical scope and override order.

runtimeVisualMutationClosure.scanKind: conservative targeted syntax overlay across the fixed 956-module set
runtimeVisualMutationClosure.dynamicRuleRule: The 53 addRule, four createCSSRule, 13 createStyleSheet, two insertRule, one deleteRule and 14 theming-participant sites are runtime visual inputs in addition to the 1281 static CSS rule nodes. The 432 syntactic registerColor calls split into 431 unique literal-ID call sites plus the colorUtils forwarding call, exactly reconciling T1's 431 runtime color identities. The 37 registerIcon call sites split into 35 literal IDs plus two iconRegistry helper calls and are not the 776-identity registry count; T1's Chrome runtime registry remains the icon-identity authority.
runtimeVisualMutationClosure.mutationRule: Every targeted row receives a candidate source-row classification and native-state effect trace. Style assignments, CSS property calls, class mutations, content writes and attribute writes preserve source ordering and visibility. The tree-call name scan is intentionally conservative and includes non-DOM collection operations; those rows are marked non-DOM with source evidence instead of being silently discarded.
runtimeVisualMutationClosure.closureRule: This overlay is a reproducible omission detector, not the definition of all observable behavior. The moduleAndResourceClosure closed-world rule remains authoritative, so an operation absent from these selected syntax names is retained exact and still requires a candidate row. The candidate cannot use this overlay to narrow the 956-module source closure.

styleResourceClosure.mappingRule: Every rule in the 98 imported sheets receives one candidate row mapped to native geometry, color, typography, icon, animation, focus, hit-test or visibility state, or to an already accepted cut or later iPadOS target. Cutting CSS selector compatibility does not cut the visible state or interaction encoded by a retained rule.
styleResourceClosure.assetRule: The Codicon font remains governed by T1 licensing and glyph identity. Two color-picker checkerboard PNG data URLs map to native drawing. Two iPad keyboard SVG data URLs remain later-iPadOS content and do not ship in the current macOS artifact.
styleResourceClosure.acceptanceRule: Retained style rows are verified by native visual, geometry, focus, accessibility, reduced-motion and high-contrast goldens. A missing row or unexplained visual delta fails C05, C07 and C10.

candidateArtifact.producer: Swift symbol graph, module mapper, runtime-effect registry, intrinsic-profile exporter and native-style registry

acceptance.C02: All retained intrinsic, binary64, encoding, hashing, clock and raw-UTF16 compatibility vectors match Chrome 151; every accepted native adaptation matches its typed trace contract.
acceptance.C04: The candidate manifest is set-equal to 956 reachable JavaScript modules, 38 unreachable-package JavaScript exclusion rows, 98 imported style resources, 84 direct global names, 8221 direct global references and every retained platform-effect row; it cross-references all 14 N1-owned localization tables and three unreachable style resources.
acceptance.C05: Retained intrinsic decisions, input-latency measurements, style states, encoding replacements and feature traces match the fixed baseline.
acceptance.C07: Native visual and accessibility projections cover every retained style state without DOM, CSS or hidden web content.
acceptance.C09: Weak references, queues, typed buffers, performance records, generated tables and style assets follow H2 bounds and disposal rules under lifecycle and soak gates.
acceptance.C10: The signed distribution contains no JavaScript engine, JavaScript or source-map resource, WebView, WebWorker, CSS runtime, network fallback, WebCrypto dependency, external diff module or unclassified source/resource/effect/package-exclusion row; Codicon is the sole core-package runtime asset and all source and asset notices are present.
acceptance.performance: P00-P13 include intrinsic hot paths, StringBuilder, SHA-1 model hashing, input-latency recording and native widget styling without changing any preregistered workload ID or dual-baseline verdict rule.
